facts.text: The building was designed by WATG, with interiors by the late Jaya Ibrahim.
facts.excerpt: the building is designed by WATG, while the late Jaya Ibrahim crafted the interior designs and John Pettigrew oversees the landscape design.

facts.text: The resort is close to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Jiuzhaigou.
facts.excerpt: situated in close proximity to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Jiuzhaigou

facts.text: The villas have sweeping views of the Minshan mountains and a design drawing from Tibetan culture.
facts.excerpt: feature sweeping views of the Minshan mountains and design drawing from Tibetan culture.

facts.text: Each villa has an expansive private terrace for watching yaks roam the land or the stars at night.
facts.excerpt: expansive private terraces provide a peaceful space to observe yaks roaming the land or stars twinkling in the vast night sky.

facts.text: Each guest is guided by a dedicated Nieba, a personal host who offers local knowledge and connects guests to resort experiences.
facts.excerpt: Guests are guided by a dedicated Nieba who serves as a source of local knowledge and connection to resort experiences.

facts.text: Bathroom amenities were created in collaboration with Frédéric Malle.
facts.excerpt: Bathroom amenities were created in collaboration with Parisian “perfume publisher” Frédéric Malle.

facts.text: La Montagne is a specialty restaurant serving Mediterranean cuisine with local ingredients.
facts.excerpt: This specialty restaurant reveals the flavors of Mediterranean cuisine with rich local ingredients.

facts.text: Cai Lin Xuan serves traditional Sichuan, Tibetan and Cantonese cuisines.
facts.excerpt: Cai Lin Xuan brings the beauty, colors and bounty of the surrounding landscape to the table through traditional Sichuan, Tibetan and Cantonese cuisines.

facts.text: Bo Ri Village serves local comfort food, with Sichuan noodles and family hot pot among its specialties.
facts.excerpt: Local specialties include Sichuan noodles and family hot pot.

facts.text: Rissai Spa has a heated indoor pool with a panoramic mountain view.
facts.excerpt: a heated indoor pool with a panoramic mountain view.

facts.text: The spa's Eaglewood Vibration Ritual combines Tibetan singing bowls with agarwood oil.
facts.excerpt: this massage combines the soothing vibrations of Tibetan singing bowls with therapeutic agarwood oil to encourage a deep state of calm.

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours and has Technogym cardio machines.
facts.excerpt: The 24-hour fitness center offers Technogym cardio machines

facts.text: Guests can go hiking, biking or stargazing in the surrounding Jiuzhaigou nature reserve.
facts.excerpt: Explore Jiuzhaigou’s 180,000-acre nature reserve with hiking and biking excursions or an evening of stargazing.

facts.text: Tibetan journeys in the surrounding villages include home visits and incense workshops.
facts.excerpt: home visits, incense workshops and other immersive experiences.

facts.text: Children's activities include arts and crafts, treasure hunts, kite-flying and organic farming.
facts.excerpt: Kids are invited to discover Jiuzhaigou and the resort with arts and crafts, treasure hunts, kite-flying and organic farming.

facts.text: The resort offers limousine transportation to and from Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport.
facts.excerpt: We offer limousine transportation to and from Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport.

facts.text: Guests can also fly by helicopter from Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport to a nearby helipad, where the resort can arrange transportation.
facts.excerpt: Guests may also travel from Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport via helicopter to a nearby helipad where we can arrange transportation to the resort.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.
